M CAD Solutions offers CAD courses like CATIA V5, SolidWorks, and UG NX, along with domain training programs such as BIW Fixture Design, Automotive Interior Plastic Trims, Robotics & Automation Simulation, and Digital Twin & Automation Design (Industry 4.0/5.0).

CATIA V5 is a CAD software by Dassault Systemes, widely used in automotive and aerospace design. The course runs for 3-6 months with a batch size of 10-15 students, covers foundation, part design, assembly design, surface design, and drafting modules, and includes industry-recognized certification.

BIW Fixture Design is a 3-month, job-oriented domain training program covering automotive Body-in-White fixture design, 3D modeling, simulation, welding gun integration, and GD&T drawing creation. It has 100 lectures, a batch size of 5 students, and leads to roles like BIW Design Engineer and Fixture Design Specialist.

This is a 3-month domain training program covering interior trim design, material selection, injection molding, and DFM for plastic parts. It has 90 lectures, a batch of 5 students, live OEM projects, and prepares you for roles like Interior Trim Design Engineer and Plastic Component Designer.
The SolidWorks course runs for 1 month, is suitable for all levels, and includes 60 lectures with expert-led instruction covering 3D modeling and design fundamentals using SolidWorks software.
The UG NX course runs for 1 month, is suitable for all levels, includes 60 lectures with practical training on the UG NX CAD platform used in mechanical design.

It's India's first ROS2-based Digital Twin robotics training program. It follows a simulation-first approach covering ROS2 foundations, mobile robot motion, and 6-DOF industrial robotic arm training, without any real hardware integration, so learners can safely master robotics fundamentals that apply to any robot in industry.
M CAD Solutions has a 98% placement rate, with over 5000 students trained and placed, and a network of 150-200+ partner companies in the automotive and manufacturing sectors.

Partner companies include Mahindra, Tata Technologies, L&T Technology Services, Kohler, Robtech Automation, Rheomold, Faith Automation, DIFACTO Robotics, and many more across automotive and manufacturing sectors.

The placement process has 6 steps: profile building (resume/portfolio), skill assessment, interview preparation with mock interviews, company connect with partner firms, placement drives, and post-placement career growth support.
